text:
Morgan: Heads-up — I'm proposing a rename in the gpufleet TF module: `kms_key_id` -> `key_arn`. Reason: make module API consistent with other modules and accept full ARN for cross-account KMS. This would be a breaking input name change. @Ria can you weigh in on compatibility approach?

Ria: I opened a draft PR with the rename. My plan is to keep a compatibility shim so downstream callers don't break immediately. Idea: accept both inputs and resolve to one internal var, emit a deprecation warning. Example snippet:```hcl
variable "key_arn" { type = string }
variable "kms_key_id" { type = string, default = null }
locals { resolved_key = var.key_arn != null ? var.key_arn : var.kms_key_id }
resource "aws_kms_key_alias" "gpufleet" { target_key_id = local.resolved_key }
```
Would that be acceptable for CI/gitops?

Sam: compatibility shim sounds good, but main pain is GitOps downstream usage. Lots of stacks set `kms_key_id` in their fleet overlays. If we accept both, we still need a plan to detect and migrate uses because we want to remove the old var after deprecation period. +1 for emitting a clear deprecation output in `terraform plan`. Also we should add a check in the module tests to cover three cases: only old var, only new var, both set (and fail if both are set to different values).

Alex: watch out for provider-level diffs. If downstream teams change alias -> ARN, some resources might be replaced depending on how we pass key (alias vs arn). Need a smoke test that provisions a tiny test fleet and runs a simple encryption op. Also recommend a capacity buffer during rollout: set reserved nodes + autoscaler headroom.

deploy-bot: CANARY APPLY FAILED in `infra-gitops/prod-canary/az3`

Error: creating instance: InvalidKMSKey
  with aws_instance.gpu[0],
  on module/gpufleet/main.tf line 213, in resource "aws_instance" "gpu":
  213: resource "aws_instance" "gpu" {

Caused by: InvalidArgument: KMS key arn not found

Ria: ugh — thanks for the bot log. Looks like one downstream repo set `kms_key_id` to an alias name (e.g. `alias/redwood-gpukms`) while the new `key_arn` path expects a full ARN. I'll add a small helper in the module to accept alias strings and translate them with `data "aws_kms_alias"` when needed. That should cover both alias and arn semantics.

Sam: Good catch. For gitops: we'll add a pre-merge linter that flags usages of the old var and rejects direct PRs to prod overlays. Instead open an automated migration PR in each overlay that updates to `key_arn` and normalizes values to full ARN (or keeps alias but uses the new helper).

Morgan: Can we avoid a major version bump? If we keep input backward-compatible (shim + alias support) and add deprecation warnings, I think we can ship as a minor bump. But we need an explicit deprecation timeline (e.g., 3 months) and an automated checklist for owners.

Ria: plan:
1) Update module: add `key_arn` (new), keep `kms_key_id` (deprecated, default = null), implement `local.resolved_key` with alias-to-arn helper, fail plan if both set with conflicting values.
2) Add terraform-docs & changelog entry with migration steps and examples.
3) Module CI: unit tests (old-only, new-only, both-same, both-conflict) + terratest smoke that does a small apply in sandbox account.
4) GitOps: add linter to catch `kms_key_id` in overlays and create auto-migration PRs for overlays that are straightforward. Block direct merges to prod overlays until migration PRs land.
5) Rollout: canary in non-prod regions (az1 then az3), validate instance creation and KMS ops, then staggered rollouts with 10% fleet batches and 30m validation.

Alex: I'll add runbook steps for on-call: how to detect KMS-related instance failures, rollback path (pin previous module version), and capacity fallback (shift traffic to Dedicated pools if needed).

Sam: I'll add the CI checks and automation scripts in infra-ci repo. Also adding a quick grep job that runs across all overlays and reports owners for migration PRs.

Morgan: Sounds good. Who's owning the migration PRs?

Ria: I'll own module changes & PR automation. Sam will own overlay migration automation + CI gating. Alex will own runbook & smoke tests. Morgan will coordinate rollout windows with product infra schedule.

Morgan: Perfect. Let's reconvene in 48h for PR status. :thumbsup:

Ria: pushing the draft PR now, will tag the related overlays and post links when ready. :rocket:

Sam: adding CI tasks to backlog and will start the automation tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary retry queued for infra-gitops/prod-canary/az3 in 15m.
